assets.label: export transfer pumps
assets.service: tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action following ICAM investigation at P-7111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on P-7111, M-7111 and PT-7111 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. P-7111 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 16 June 2021 a corrective action on P-7111, M-7111 and PT-7111 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
